name: Two-level Nested Ray Marching
aliases: Ray Marching with Coarse Mesh and Refinement Tree
definition: A volume rendering method using a constant adjustable step size, performing a two-level nested march: first across coarse mesh elements, then across descendant elements within the refinement tree.
summary: Two-level nested ray marching is a volume rendering technique for AMR data that decouples traversal into coarse mesh skipping and fine refinement compositing.
